specificFindings: Disappointing qualifies Rockets regular-season finish,not their later title,the opponents elimination or all sports experience. Regular season and playoffs remain different stages.
Utah initially2-1 in best-of-five is distinguished from later2-2 and the Phoenix3-1 best-of-seven. Series game counts are not converted to single-game points.
One more Utah win would advance Utah; Houstons actual fourth-game win instead ties the series. Conditional consequences are not recorded as completed results or assigned to the wrong team.

Game5 returns to Utah. The home-court question raises suspense immediately answered Nope,Houston wins95-91. This is the books historical narrative,not present-day prediction or proof home advantage never matters.

Second round opponent is number2 Phoenix; conference finals opponent is number1 San Antonio. Utah first round and Orlando later finals are kept separate. Distractors were refined to plausible round,venue,lead and rank confusions.
Phoenix leads3-1; another Houston loss would end Houstons season,so Houston needs three consecutive wins. The counterfactual risk is not an assertion that Houston actually lost again.

Uncharacteristically indicates a departure from the players usual performance,not a reported career percentage,guaranteed lifelong misses or an unstated injury cause. Regulation and overtime are not treated as separate seasons.
The authors repeated I thought it was over is personal expectation. But it wasnt negates the implied over,distinguishing feared elimination from the eventual continuation.
Rudy Tomjanovich is named as head coach and quote speaker. Olajuwon is a player. Heart of a champion is motivational rhetoric,not a physiological measurement or rule that champions cannot lose.
The1995-under-dog comparison is the authors moving and dramatic viewing appraisal linked to expanded possibilities,not a controlled all-viewer effect or automatically greater happiness.
The arts/sports synthesis is read with requires our own interpretation and under the right circumstances. It is not an isolated automatic effect of every cultural activity on every person.

In this sense refers to interpreting creators expression and recognising athletic beauty. Different from personal adventures does not mean unreal or incapable of immediate experience; nonetheless explicitly preserves that possibility.

Proust often sick and refraining from travelling too far is a limited physical-exploration description,not a claim he never moved or a newly diagnosed condition. Worlds in the preceding art quotation are literary,not a completed travel log.
Ebert over10000 watched and over6000 written are different lower-bound quantities in the book,not exact equal totals or one review per film. No claim of fresh current tally verification is added.
Most forgotten versus those deemed worth remembering describes selective retention,not perfect permanent recall or random selection imposed by the author.

Hoping to be touched in secret places is an emotional metaphor and expectation in a closing quotation,not actual physical contact or a measurement of universal effects. The following inner-richness relation is reflective synthesis,not a numerical causal law.
Transported and transformed concern immersion beyond habitual experience. Sometimes new perspective preserves conditionality. In short summarizes rather than introducing a new experiment.

Schindlers List cry-and-cry is an author-facing emotional example alongside interest and awe,not recorded user behaviour or guaranteed measured audience response. Richness is not reduced to cheerfulness.

So what voices an imagined sceptical challenge about significance. The complete parent gives the benefits-versus-diversion context,but the exact target question alone is quoted to keep later unassigned source IDs pending. It is not an actual user utterance or final author denial.
